commands.name: test
commands.description: Runs each project's `test` script. Projects without one (the Next apps) are skipped rather than failing the command.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Runs ESLint across packages/, apps/ and tools/ using the `lint` autoinstaller. Enforces react-hooks/rules-of-hooks; see docs/RENDER-BOUNDARY.md.

commands.name: docs
commands.summary: Generate the Forms v2 API reference
commands.description: Runs TypeDoc over the Forms v2 packages (typedoc.json) into api-docs/, using the `docs` autoinstaller. Fails on any warning, including an undocumented export; see docs/FORMS-V2-PLAN.md phase 1. Needs a built tree (`rush build`): the packages resolve each other through their lib/ types.

commands.name: publish-check
commands.description: Shows what `rush publish-latest` and `rush publish-alpha` would publish, without publishing: the stable packages (version policy `stable`) and the Forms v2 alphas (`forms-v2-alpha`). Only versions newer than the registry's are published.
commands.shellCommand: XDG_CONFIG_HOME="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}" rush publish --include-all --version-policy stable --tag latest && XDG_CONFIG_HOME="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}" rush publish --include-all --version-policy forms-v2-alpha --tag alpha

commands.name: publish-latest
commands.summary: Publish the stable packages to npm `latest`
commands.description: Publishes @rx-controls/core, @rx-controls/react and the compat package (version policy `stable`) to the `latest` dist-tag, each only if its version is newer than the registry's. Never publishes the Forms v2 alphas. XDG_CONFIG_HOME is preserved so browser authentication works. Builds those packages and their dependencies first, so `lib/` is never stale, and publishes nothing if the build fails.
commands.shellCommand: rush build --to version-policy:stable && XDG_CONFIG_HOME="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}" rush publish --include-all --version-policy stable --publish --tag latest --set-access-level public -b main

commands.name: publish-alpha
commands.summary: Publish the Forms v2 packages to npm `alpha`
commands.description: Publishes the six Forms v2 packages (version policy `forms-v2-alpha`) to the `alpha` dist-tag, each only if its version is newer than the registry's. Never touches `latest`. Access is set public, which a scoped package's first publish needs. XDG_CONFIG_HOME is preserved so browser authentication works. Builds those packages and their dependencies first, so `lib/` is never stale, and publishes nothing if the build fails.
commands.shellCommand: rush build --to version-policy:forms-v2-alpha && XDG_CONFIG_HOME="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}" rush publish --include-all --version-policy forms-v2-alpha --publish --tag alpha --set-access-level public -b main
